description: This file defines the ThemeVariables class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the CorporateBranding plugin's DTO namespace. The class encapsulates theme-related color and gradient variables with getters and a factory method.

classes.name: ThemeVariables
classes.description: A data transfer object that holds theme color variables, including primary and secondary colors, font colors, and gradient colors, with methods to access these properties and create an instance from an array.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing all theme color properties.

methods.name: getPrimaryGradientStartColor
methods.description: Returns the starting color of the primary gradient.

methods.name: getPrimaryGradientEndColor
methods.description: Returns the ending color of the primary gradient.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a ThemeVariables instance from an associative array containing theme attributes.
